title: mp3amp~
description: `mp3amp~` is an Icecast/SHOUTcast client for Pure Data that plays livestreams or files and outputs decoded audio for objects such as `dac~`. Connect with `connect <host> <mountpoint> <port>` or `connecturl <URL>`; `standby 1` freezes decoding to reduce CPU load while packets continue to be read and ignored.
